1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Look up an item in the case system.
3	
4	  case <ID> [--json]
5	"""
6	import json
7	import sys
8	import textwrap
9	import zlib
10	from pathlib import Path
11	
12	STORE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / ".cases/store.dat"
13	MAGIC = b"WLC1"
14	
15	
16	def load():
17	    data = STORE.read_bytes()
18	    if data[:4] != MAGIC:
19	        sys.exit("case: unreadable store")
20	    return json.loads(zlib.decompress(data[4:]))
21	
22	
23	def render(item):
24	    wrap = lambda s: textwrap.wrap(s, 88) or [""]  # noqa: E731
25	    out = [f"{item['id']}  {item['title']}",
26	           f"status: {item['status']}   priority: {item['priority']}   area: {item['area']}   "
27	           f"reported: {item['reported']} by {item['reporter']}", ""]
28	    out += wrap(item["description"])
29	    out += ["", "Acceptance:"] + [f"  {x}" for x in wrap(item["acceptance"])]
30	    out += ["", "Files:"] + ([f"  {f}" for f in item["files"]] or ["  (none)"])
31	    return "\n".join(out)
32	
33	
34	def main(argv):
35	    ids = [a for a in argv if not a.startswith("-")]
36	    if len(ids) != 1:
37	        print("usage: case <ID> [--json]", file=sys.stderr)
38	        return 2
39	    key = ids[0].strip().upper()
40	    item = next((x for x in load() if x["id"] == key), None)
41	    if item is None:
42	        print(f"case: no item {key} in the case system", file=sys.stderr)
43	        return 1
44	    print(json.dumps(item, indent=2, sort_keys=True) if "--json" in argv else render(item))
45	    return 0
46	
47	
48	if __name__ == "__main__":
49	    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Generate wardline/generated/registry.py from registry/*.csv.
3	
4	  python3 tools/gen.py                 write it
5	  python3 tools/gen.py --check         fail if it is out of date
6	  python3 tools/gen.py --root DIR      work on another checkout
7	"""
8	import sys
9	from pathlib import Path
10	
11	OUT = "wardline/generated/registry.py"
12	
13	
14	def parse(text):
15	    lines = [line for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()]
16	    header = [h.strip() for h in lines[0].split(",")]
17	    rows = {}
18	    for line in lines[1:]:
19	        cells = [c.strip() for c in line.split(",")]
20	        cells += [""] * (len(header) - len(cells))
21	        rows[cells[0].upper()] = {h: (int(v) if v.isdigit() else v) for h, v in zip(header, cells) if h != "code"}
22	    return rows
23	
24	
25	def render(root):
26	    out = ["# Generated by tools/gen.py from registry/*.csv. Do not edit by hand.", "", "TABLES = {"]
27	    for path in sorted((Path(root) / "registry").glob("*.csv")):
28	        rows = parse(path.read_text())
29	        out.append(f"    {path.stem!r}: {{")
30	        for code in sorted(rows):
31	            fields = ", ".join(f"{k!r}: {rows[code][k]!r}" for k in sorted(rows[code]))
32	            out.append(f"        {code!r}: {{{fields}}},")
33	        out.append("    },")
34	    out += ["}", ""]
35	    return "\n".join(out)
36	
37	
38	def main(argv):
39	    root = Path(argv[argv.index("--root") + 1]) if "--root" in argv else Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
40	    text = render(root)
41	    target = root / OUT
42	    if "--check" in argv:
43	        if not target.exists() or target.read_text() != text:
44	            print(f"error: {OUT} is out of date with registry/*.csv, run 'make gen'", file=sys.stderr)
45	            return 1
46	        return 0
47	    target.write_text(text)
48	    print(f"wrote {OUT}")
49	    return 0
50	
51

53	    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
